why: counted before starting a long run
result: 5 implementation units planned, theme-engine and UI design-only

decision: manifest.yml + parse boundary + registry rewire + idempotent SyncService landed; seeds source array and MATURE_SOURCE_KEYS deleted
why: collapse three sources of truth into one so adding or updating an adapter touches one file
result: sync tests 7/7 green, scraper suite 791/791 green

decision: extended existing adapter_coverage_test into the contract gate: manifest parses, every adapter dir registered, every entry inherits BaseAdapter, browse and filter contracts hold
why: an adapter added without registration or drifting from the contract should fail CI, not break at runtime

decision: replaced hand-rolled health-status constant, inclusion validation, and define_method predicates with a native string-backed Rails enum; deleted the unused usable scope and simplified evaluator memoization
why: user flagged over-abstraction; Rails enum gives predicates, validation, and scopes for free, and the speculative scope had no callers

decision: health derived as a native Rails enum (healthy/degraded/broken/dead) from smoke runs and series check failures, windowed to the last adapter version bump; hourly passive sweep job, no new network traffic
why: one place now answers whether a source is usable; a version bump grants probation so a fix is not damned by stale failures

decision: bulk migration now auto-links unlinked series when the target search clears 0.8 confidence; scoring extracted to Sources::TitleMatcher shared with discovery; dropped the one-big-transaction wrap so one slow or failing series cannot roll back the batch
why: the old bulk path dead-ended every series not already linked to the target, making bulk migration useless for the main use case
result: migration tests 14/14 green incl 4 new auto-link cases

decision: verified the whole against the done predicate: manifest is sole truth, sync idempotent, conformance gate live, health derived and idempotent, bulk auto-link working
why: predicate verification on the real suite, not per-unit checks alone
evidence: full suite 1311 runs 0 failures 0 errors; rubocop clean on all touched files

decision: raised auto-link bar to 0.9 so only exact normalized title matches link unattended; containment matches stay manual
why: cross-model reviewer caught that substring containment scored exactly at the old 0.8 bar, risking wrong links like Berserk -> Berserk of Gluttony

decision: broken/dead sources skipped in scheduled chapter checks (scheduler and worker), excluded from search fan-out and migration discovery candidates; migration from a broken/dead source untouched since discovery never calls it
why: no point burning the full search timeout per request on a source we know cannot answer

decision: recovery without the cancelled daily probe: hourly sweep gives each broken source one cheap search probe on a backoff (6h under 3 days broken, 24h under 14, weekly after); a success heals it because the evaluator now discounts series failures older than the latest successful run; when the current domain fails and the community feed knows a different one, the probe tries it and adopts it stickily on success
why: skipping checks for broken sources removes all fresh signals, so something must knock; sticky adoption avoids the flip-flop a conditional override would cause

decision: keiyoushi extensions index mirrored daily into upstream_sources (schema-validated, data-only, never touches Source rows, missing entries keep their rows); 21 of 25 manifest entries linked by mihon_id; admin Source Catalog page lists the full index with implemented badges
why: user wanted the community feed as canonical catalog without maintaining our own; real ingest upserted 2108 sources, 0 skipped, all 21 links resolved
result: service 4/4, controller 4/4 green; manga_see batoto manga_buddy zero_scans absent from feed

why: PR 52 review rounds showed partial resets at call sites are the dominant bug class; one named home prevents the next one
evidence: 60bde3a; suite 1366 runs 0 failures with zero test edits

why: user decision; machine adds InvalidTransition on undeclared edges and per-edge declared consequences
evidence: ff222af; suite 1366/0 untouched; runner smoke proved non-bang in-memory, bang persistence, invalid-edge raise

decision: DNS rebinding TOCTOU closed in Scrapers::HttpClient: per-request resolve via PublicUrl::SYSTEM_RESOLVER in the faraday-net_http adapter config block, internal hosts/addresses refused (InternalHostRefusedError), first public address pinned with Net::HTTP#ipaddr= so Host/SNI/cert verification stay on the hostname; proxied connections left to the proxy; unresolvable hosts left to Net::HTTP
why: ipaddr= is the native net-http mechanism (conn_address uses @ipaddr, SNI and post_connection_check use @address); middleware URL-rewrite would verify certs against the IP
result: suite 1375/0; live: pin to 8.8.8.8 gave peeraddr=8.8.8.8 hostname-mismatch, real fetch 200
